findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_token_balances, get_blog_articles, get_crypto_news, purchase_tokens_x402, purchase_tokens_x402_solana, get_price_stream_url, get_sentiment_stream_url, agent_start, agent_link_telegram, agent_notification_settings · Private data: save_oanda_credentials, delete_oanda_credentials, save_broker_credentials, trade_market_order, trade_limit_order, trade_stop_order, replace_pending_order, refresh_instrument_data, get_token_balances, get_market_movers, analyze_asset, purchase_tokens_x402, x402_solana_config, x402_evm_config, purchase_tokens_x402_solana, fetch, scan_market, chart_chat_proxy, research_briefing · Public sink: trade_limit_order, get_token_balances, x402_solana_config, x402_evm_config, agent_start · Destructive: delete_oanda_credentials, trade_modify_trade, replace_pending_order, get_account_history, analyze_asset, remove_from_watchlist, fetch, scan_market, agent_start, agent_modify, backtest_run, backtest_save_params.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_token_balances, get_blog_articles, get_crypto_news, purchase_tokens_x402, purchase_tokens_x402_solana, get_price_stream_url, get_sentiment_stream_url, agent_start, agent_link_telegram, agent_notification_settings · Private data: save_oanda_credentials, delete_oanda_credentials, save_broker_credentials, trade_market_order, trade_limit_order, trade_stop_order, replace_pending_order, refresh_instrument_data, get_token_balances, get_market_movers, analyze_asset, purchase_tokens_x402, x402_solana_config, x402_evm_config, purchase_tokens_x402_solana, fetch, scan_market, chart_chat_proxy, research_briefing · Public sink: trade_limit_order, get_token_balances, x402_solana_config, x402_evm_config, agent_start · Destructive: delete_oanda_credentials, trade_modify_trade, replace_pending_order, get_account_history, analyze_asset, remove_from_watchlist, fetch, scan_market, agent_start, agent_modify, backtest_run, backtest_save_params

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
